text:
Becca: Hey finance, booked a hotel for DevRel conf in Berlin and my roommate (external contractor) paid half at checkout with their card. Hotel folio shows a single charge €420 for the room, but their card receipt only shows 'ROOM CHARGE' with no company name. Can we put half on Redwood and half as contractor expense to be reimbursed to them?

Jon: Quick Q: Is the contractor listed on a contractor PO or SOW? We need billing instructions and confirmation they're allowed to be reimbursed through our portal.

Becca: Contractor is Freelance: Evan Park, on SOW #SOW-221 (I attached SOW). Evan covered €210 at checkout and sent a photo of his card receipt: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/evan_room_0326.jpg The hotel folio (folio.pdf) is here: https://files.redwood.example/invoices/folio_berlin_0326.pdf

Priya: Two things: (1) We usually prefer contractor expenses be billed to the company and reimbursed to the contractor via AP. (2) For VAT reclaim we need the hotel invoice showing VAT reg no and guest name. Does the folio show VAT?

Becca: Folio shows VAT summary but guest name is blank. Hotel says they can reissue folio with guest name "Evan Park" or "Redwood Inference - Evan Park". Which should we request?

AP-bot: Automated checklist: If contractor pays and is reimbursed, attach (a) contractor invoice or expense form, (b) contractor bank details, (c) SOW/authorization, (d) hotel folio, (e) proof of payment by contractor. VAT reclaim requires invoice with VAT reg no and payee name matching billed entity.

Priya: Request hotel reissue two things: (A) an invoice addressed to Redwood Inference Ltd with VAT reg number for the company portion (€210), and (B) a separate invoice or receipt in Evan Park's name for his €210 so he can claim reimburse. If hotel can't split, have them issue a single invoice showing guest name "Evan Park" and include company reference lines so AP can allocate internally.

Becca: I emailed hotel reservations asking for either a split invoice or a single invoice with guest name + invoice address Redwood. Sent: https://files.redwood.example/outbox/hotel_request_2050001234.eml (transaction ref H-9876).

Jon: Meanwhile for processing: create two expense entries in the portal:
- Line 1: Hotel room €210 -> paid by corporate card -> GL 6401 -> tag PROJ-71 -> attach folio + confirmation email
- Line 2: Reimbursement to contractor Evan Park €210 -> paid personal card (contractor) -> create AP vendor "Evan Park (contractor)" and attach proof of payment + SOW -> code GL 7005 Contractor reimbursables

AP-bot: Note: AP will not pay contractor until contractor bank details and W9/W8 (tax form) are on file. Please have Evan submit the contractor expense form here: https://vendor.redwood.example/contractor-expense

Becca: Evan uploaded his proof and bank details to vendor portal and confirmed tax form on file. Linked here: https://vendor.redwood.example/evanpark/profile

Priya: Perfect. Once hotel reissues invoice with VAT info we can reclaim company portion. If hotel cannot provide VAT reg no, company portion will be non-reclaimable and coded to GL 6555. AP will hold contractor reimbursement until documents validated.

Becca: Copy that. Submitted the two entries: https://expenses.redwood.example/submit/2050001234 and attached SOW + contractor upload. Thanks!

finance-bot: Thread closed by finance-bot: next steps = wait for hotel invoice reissue -> AP to process contractor pay once docs verified -> VAT reclaim if invoice valid.
